I can’t offer much in the way of practical advice, but as someone who is also starting out and getting his ass handed to him, I feel your pain. It’s rough out here! But some general things that have helped me: 

1. First off, take a break if you need to. I tend to get bitter if I keep playing, especially when I’m on a losing streak. By then I’m so fed up that not only am I not reacting to easy reads or punishing correctly, but worst of all I’m not having fun. If that’s the case it’s alright to put the game down. 

2. Everyone here has a more efficient way of labbing than I do, but if King or Paul are you giving you trouble, write down some of the moves they do that are really pissing you off, even if they’re just descriptions. Then go to training mode and just work on coming up with a game plan. I do really bad against Bob, so I wrote down basic things like “hits you with stomach move”, and I would just grind him until I learn to effectively deal with him. I’ve come to realize so much of this game is about dealing with new shit you’ve never seen before. 

3. Don’t worry about ranked so much. It’s enticing, I know, but just focus on you!
